source.upscale_note: 1920x1080 is Lanczos enlargement from 1280x720; no extra source detail is created

selected_reason: Highest tested JPEG quality whose MJP1 video plus PCM average fits the historical 80% SPI service reserve; compare burst windows separately.

mjp.sector_padding: JPEG payload rounded up to 512-byte sector per frame

resource_usage.measurement_method: PowerShell polls process working sets every 500 ms with Get-Process while prepare_media1080.py runs and accumulates matching ffmpeg.exe working sets.
resource_usage.measurement_run: full 300-frame encode, four JPEG qualities, audio extraction and MJP packing
resource_usage.note: Per-process Python peak was below 150 MiB; combined Python plus FFmpeg working set was above 150 MiB. Working-set sampling is approximate and excludes other processes.
